strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Existing task.run now revalidates product-continuation provenance before execution, so restarted headless callers can safely run an admitted continuation task without owning source-decision freshness logic.
Rust fails closed before TaskRunning when the stored product-continuation provenance no longer matches the latest source product decision and expected fingerprints.
The phase keeps the existing explicit task.run agent-loop execution path rather than adding routing wrappers or automatic execution.

The guard derives freshness from bounded existing product decision ledger evidence and keeps context metadata bounded instead of storing raw prompts, provider responses, files, commands, paths, or secrets.
Operators can trust that a product-continuation task that reaches TaskRunning was admitted from current continue_development evidence, not stale source state.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting runtime_permission_enforcement, agent_loop, context_management, and progress_visualization.
answers.new_capability: Existing task.run now refuses to start a Created product-continuation task when its stored provenance no longer matches the latest source continue_development product decision and expected fingerprints.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M53.1 and M53.1.1 validate product-continuation task creation and replay, but current task.run does not revalidate product_continuation_provenance before TaskRunning.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: A previously admitted continuation task can execute after the source product decision is superseded, leaving source-decision freshness outside Rust runtime authority.
answers.non_duplicative: Distinct from M53.1 admission, M53.1.1 request binding, and M52.2 product policy ownership because it changes the existing task.run execution admission boundary.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. The phase changes existing task.run admission behavior only.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. It adds no report, digest, history, readiness, verdict, inspection, preview, dashboard, or summary-only surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: Rust revalidates product-continuation provenance before TaskRunning and denies stale or terminal source decisions before execution side effects.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: A headless caller can safely use task.start(product_continuation_source) followed by task.run(task_id) across restarts without reconstructing product-decision freshness externally.
answers.milestone_progress: This closes the proven M53 run-boundary freshness gap and makes M53 closeout assessment plausible without adding a product-continuation routing wrapper.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M53.2 updates the current and archived phase manifests for a real task.run admission behavior change. Review must confirm guard enforcement is not weakened and this is not a product-continuation routing wrapper.

exit_criteria: Existing task.run remains the only execution boundary for M53 product-continuation tasks; no new RPC or headless.continue_once route is added
A valid Created product-continuation task revalidates latest source continue_development and plan_next_phase evidence before TaskRunning
A superseded source product decision fails closed before TaskRunning for a still-Created continuation task
A latest source product_complete or blocked_by_product_evidence decision fails closed before TaskRunning
Stale decision, accepted-completion, terminal-completion, completion-closure, product-evidence, or bounded capability metadata mismatches fail closed before execution side effects
Terminal task.run replay remains duplicate-free and does not append a new TaskRunning because source product evidence changed after the task already ran

RPC and ledger metadata remain bounded and exclude raw prompts, provider responses, final responses, file content, diffs, stdout/stderr, commands, environment, raw requests, raw ledger payloads, absolute paths, canonical paths, and secrets
behavior_evidence: Rust behavior test task_run_revalidates_product_continuation_provenance_before_running validates a current continuation task reaches TaskRunning, a superseded product decision is denied before TaskRunning, and terminal replay remains duplicate-free.

Rust behavior test task_start_admits_product_continuation_and_replays_without_running continues to validate admission replay, request binding, stale admission denials, no automatic run, and raw-field exclusion.

accepted_capability: Existing task.run revalidates product-continuation provenance against the latest source product decision before TaskRunning for Created continuation tasks.
safety_boundary: Only Created product-continuation tasks are revalidated before TaskRunning; terminal replay remains existing task.run behavior
Latest source decision must remain continue_development with next_action plan_next_phase
Expected decision, accepted-completion, terminal-completion, completion-closure, and product-evidence fingerprints must match stored provenance
No new routing wrapper, no automatic execution, and no VSIX-owned policy
Ledger and RPC expose only bounded ids, statuses, next actions, replay state, SHA-256 fingerprints, and bounded capability metadata
non_goals: No product-continuation run routing or headless.continue_once extension
No report, digest, history, readiness, verdict, inspection, preview, dashboard, or summary-only wrapper
No automatic planning, task run, provider call, verification, apply, shell, git, network, service, or workspace mutation
No raw Product Charter, manifest, spec, ledger, prompt, provider, file, command, output, environment, absolute path, canonical path, or secret exposure
No global technical-debt registry or broad runtime modularization in this phase
rejected_alternatives: Extending headless.continue_once was rejected because it would wrap the existing task.run execution path while direct task.run remained the authority.
Adding a new run-routing RPC was rejected because existing task.run is the intended execution boundary.
Report/readiness/history/inspection surfaces were rejected because they do not change execution admission behavior.
Terminal replay freshness failure was rejected because already-run task replay must stay duplicate-free and stable.
technical_debt: Global technical-debt registry remains a later priority so unresolved M50.1 admission atomicity does not disappear from active manifests.
crates/brownie-runtime/src/lib.rs remains large and should be split only by a future move-only refactor.
M53 closeout should assess whether product continuation now needs no further wrapper phase.
next_capability_rationale: After this phase, M53 should move to closeout assessment; if not complete, the next phase must prove a distinct runtime capability beyond task.run freshness.
